CommunityApplications.Profile: IPTV Tunerr turns IPTV providers and M3U sources into a complete live TV backend for Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin: an HDHomeRun-emulating tuner, a custom merged XMLTV guide with automatic EPG repair, a resilient stream gateway (HLS/DASH relay, optional ffmpeg, failover, shared sessions), DVR and request-driven recording rules, lineup curation and channel health scoring, VOD over FUSE or WebDAV, Plex integration tools, and an authenticated operator dashboard. Keep tuner access on a trusted LAN or VPN.
